notes.title: Join the official Super Gorilla Quest/Wither Games Discord server!
notes.notes: Here you can track updates of my newest games (including Super Gorilla Quest 2: A Space Chimpanzee) and chat about them! Here is the link: https://discord.gg/FsAjY6pKtm

notes.title: Use the official Super Gorilla Quest Walkthrough!
notes.notes: Hello gorilla fans! After many hard minutes of work, the official Super Gorilla Quest walkthrough containing guides on how to find everything in the game is available on GameFAQS and Steam. Check it out if you need help or get lost!

notes.title: Sequel in Development
notes.notes: Hello gorilla fans, I would like to announce the fact that Super Gorilla Quest 2 is officially being worked on. I have no idea when it's coming out but it's gonna be the best game ever made. Get hyped.

notes.title: Two playlists for the game on Spotify
notes.notes: Hello! I just wanted to inform the players of this game that I've created two Spotify playlists relating to this on Spotify, one containing the game's complete soundtrack (https://open.spotify.com/playlist/7Hhs0QNJtA3Qf0bfQYoBe1?si=3927dc45b1d54d37) and the other containing songs not in the soundtrack that really fit the theme and style of the game (https://open.spotify.com/playlist/2dUzMi7W6ITKxCu2WIMKAV?si=db1c4808d2da44ab). Enjoy!
